CustomField.description: Ticked when the Board's old licensing system (CLOSE) records an affidavit for this person: CLOSE kept no count, only a comment such as "Cert mailed to TX 01/01/23" or "Aff mailed". The first affidavit ever is free, so when this is ticked the Affidavit Request form charges the fee. Set by the data migration.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when CLOSE shows an earlier affidavit, so the free first affidavit has been used.
CustomField.label: Earlier Affidavit In CLOSE
